en: Allow me to teach you the workings{SAUT}of justice and peace!
I don't care to learn something{SAUT}so presumptuous as that.
I forgive none who disrupt the peace{SAUT}of Kamo City!
Ngh... Impossible!{PAGE}I am absolute justice! How could I be{SAUT}toppled by such scoundrels!?
You fools! Why can't you understand!?{PAGE}I am the arbiter of justice! All you have{SAUT}to do is shut up and obey me!
Ngh―to think you'd entrap me like this!{SAUT}Damn evildoers, cursing Kamo City!
